canon: Bestia veloz de seis patas y piel rojiza que se camufla en el polvo de la llanura: hocico alargado con grandes bigotes, ojos oscuros y redondos, orejas pequeñas pegadas al cráneo y una hilera de placas óseas superpuestas por el lomo hasta una cola larga y afilada en la punta. Va en manadas siguiendo las corrientes subterráneas; los clanes orcos la cazan en cacerías rituales (hoy bajo moratoria, presa sagrada). Huidiza. Macho con marcas oscuras a lo largo del lomo, para el trote largo; hembra de un rojizo claro uniforme, para el sprint corto.

prompt.sujeto: A lean, fast six-legged runner of the plains with a long, narrow body and long, slender legs built for speed.
prompt.proporcion: Its body is as long as four of its own heads, its legs are longer than its chest is deep, and its thin tail is as long as its body.
prompt.ancla: a greyhound, only longer in the body
prompt.cuerpo: Its hairless, leathery skin is rust red, the colour of the dust around it. Its muzzle is long and narrow, with long pale whiskers sweeping back from the snout, its eyes are dark and round, and its small ears lie flat against the skull.
rasgos: A row of overlapping brown bone plates runs from the nape along the whole spine and onto the long tail, which narrows to a sharp point.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: Its three pairs of legs are spaced evenly along the body, the middle pair just behind the chest, and fine creases run across the skin at every joint.
prompt.pose: Seen in full side profile from a low camera angle, it leaps mid-stride across the frame from left to right, its legs stretched fore and aft and its head turned slightly toward the viewer.
prompt.manada: Behind it a herd of lean six-legged runners with rust-red skin and plated backs races through a rolling cloud of dust, blurred and hazy with distance.
prompt.entorno: The ground is cracked red earth with sparse dry tufts, and the dust kicked up by the herd hangs low over the plain toward a hazy horizon.
prompt.luz: Bright, hazy daylight from high on the left warms the rust skin and the edges of the plates, while a thick orange haze of dust glows behind the herd.

rasgos+: This male has dark markings running along the back beside the plates, and his legs are long and sturdy, built for a long, steady trot.
This female is slighter, with a light, even rust skin and long, fine legs built for short bursts of speed.

momento:atardecer.luz: The low sun sits behind the herd and rims the skin and plates with fiery orange light, while the drifting dust glows in the backlight.

momento:noche.luz: Under a starry night sky with a soft, even pearly glow, a cool silver-blue light rims the skin and plates, while thin dust drifts low in deep cool shadow over the plain.

capas.corto: A single lean six-legged runner, full body in side view facing left, leaping across the centre of the frame with all feet off the ground. Hazy warm daylight from the upper right. It has the long lizard-like body of a greyhound, an otter's head with a long muzzle and long pale whiskers, and tight leathery rust-brown skin like a rhino's. Overlapping brown plates, like an armadillo's bands, cover its back from neck to tail. Its long whip-thin tail ends in a point. Two forelegs fold under its chest and four long hind legs stretch back. Cracked red earth, a cloud of dust, a blurred herd running behind.
capas.sujeto: A single lean six-legged runner, seen in full body from the side facing left, leaping in mid-air, centred in the image and filling about half the image height.
capas.luz: Hazy warm daylight from the upper right through a veil of dust: the plates on the back and the muscles of the haunch are lit, the underside and the far legs are in soft shadow, and a long dark shadow of the body lies on the ground beneath it.
capas.tamano: Longer than a horse from chest to tail root, with a tail as long as its whole body; its feet are well above the cracked earth in the leap, and the herd behind is much smaller with distance.
capas.forma: A long, low lizard-like body with the deep chest and narrow waist of a greyhound. A neck held up and forward, a small head like an otter's with a long blunt muzzle, round dark eyes, small round ears set close to the skull, and two small curved horns pointing back from the top of the head. Long pale whiskers sweep back from the muzzle like a catfish's. Along the back runs a row of broad overlapping plates, like the bands of an armadillo, from the neck over the haunches and onto the tail, which is long, thin and whip-like and ends in a sharp point. Two forelegs are folded up against the chest with clawed feet, and four long hind legs in two pairs stretch backwards, each ending in a clawed foot.
capas.entorno: In the foreground, red clay earth cracked like a dry lake bed, scattered with small dark stones. In the middle distance, a thick cloud of orange dust kicked up on the left and a trail of dust behind its feet on the right. On the horizon, low flat-topped hills fading in the haze under a cloudy amber sky.
capas.color: Rust-brown leathery skin with darker brown folds at the joints; brown bone plates with paler edges; pale grey whiskers; dark brown eyes; red-brown cracked earth; orange-brown dust.
capas.repetir: Behind it, eight or ten more of the same runners at different distances, running the same way in a haze of dust, small, blurred and pale with distance.
capas.paleta: rust brown, burnt orange and dusty tan with one accent of pale cream
capas.notas: IMG-55, escrita mirando el banner. Macho. El banner solo se mira de perfil: no se ven las marcas oscuras del lomo del macho (canon), solo placas. Diferencias con el canon: dos cuernecillos curvos hacia atrás en la cabeza (el canon no los tiene; ya no se quitan); piel sin pelo, curtida y escamosa (el canon dice «piel rojiza»); placas pardas como bandas de armadillo, no 'superpuestas' genéricas; cuerpo de lagarto largo con cola de látigo; el salto con las seis patas en el aire (4 traseras atrás, 2 delanteras plegadas); bigotes claros; manada de 8-10 en polvareda; suelo de arcilla agrietada y mesas lejanas. Ver banner-vs-canon.md.
